longform.headline: The sidewalk becomes a screen
longform.opening: A private room can acquire a public face without surrendering its gate. The evidence reveals a system of coordination rather than a single machine.

sections.heading: RUNWAY360’s promise
sections.copy: CFDA launched RUNWAY360 with support for livestreams, AR/VR, 360-degree media and social integrations during the September 2020 digital pivot.

sections.heading: The public screen experiment
sections.copy: In September 2025, CFDA and Rockefeller Center announced public NYFW streams at the Rink and Channel Gardens, supported by Genesys.

sections.heading: Distribution is not admission
sections.copy: No equivalent public-screen partnership for September 2026 is assumed until an organizer or venue publishes one.
